name: filters_post_projects
title: Filters Post Projects
description: Filter + keyword search toolbar for a post-items listing (look and drawer from filters_toolbar). Linked by "id" to the <ul id> of the listing; filters, sort and texts come from the "projects" toolbar in data_items_listing_toolbar.json, options from the same posts the listing shows (post_type, filter_by, exclude_by, sort).
